description: Specialist asset backlog: 12 bounded review-only proposals; six CI producer jobs run independently. No auto-merge.

tasks.goal: Inspect M22 five digits per hand, anatomical proportions, knuckle transitions, and connected human silhouette without changing gameplay.
Improve facial contours, ears, jaw and eyelids with source geometry and 14-angle evidence.
Design density and topology target suitable for sculpt source, retopology, mobile LODs and later glTF export.
Design physically based skin roughness, subsurface-friendly albedo, pores and micro-normal atlas.
Produce layered stone, patinated steel, leather and cloth material source tests.
Validate deformation under shoulder, elbow, wrist and finger bends, with five-digit hands.
Plan strand and cloth dynamics as separate attachable simulation assets; hair can be deferred.
Improve architectural silhouette with worn edge bevels, modular ruins and material variation.
Plan rocks, flora and terrain scatter assets with deterministic seeds, LOD, and draw budgets.
Collect 14-angle real-mesh previews, consistent lighting and dimension reports for review.
Compare 14-angle mesh views and Android Model Atelier screenshots without claiming equal render quality.
Plan Blender/glTF export pipeline with texture space, skin weights and asset metadata, preserving originals.
